sources.title: The new 2025 Porsche Taycan models (Porsche newsroom US)
sources.notes: Performance Battery Plus gross 105 kWh (up from 93 kWh); up to 320 kW at 800 V; 18 min under ideal conditions; 150 kW DC/DC converter standard. No usable figure, no AC figure, no per-trim pack list.

sources.title: 2025 Porsche Taycan Pricing, Specs Overview (InsideEVs)
sources.notes: Table: base battery 89.0 kWh gross / 82.3 usable, up to 270 kW, 10-80% 18 min, AC 9.6 kW; Performance Battery Plus 105.0 gross / 97.0 usable, up to 320 kW, 18 min, AC 9.6 kW. Trims on 105 kWh: 4 and 4S Cross Turismo, Turbo, Turbo S, Turbo Cross Turismo, Turbo S Cross Turismo, Turbo GT (and Weissach); Taycan RWD and 4S 89 or 105 kWh. GTS not covered.

sources.title: The 2025 Porsche Taycan Gets Major Upgrades In Range, Performance And Charging (InsideEVs)
sources.notes: Performance Battery 89 kWh standard on Taycan and 4S (Plus optional); Performance Battery Plus 105 kWh standard on Turbo, Turbo S and all Cross Turismo; up to 320 kW (was 270); 18 min.

sources.title: Porsche Taycan new entry-level model rear-wheel drive, two sizes of battery (Porsche newsroom, 2021)
sources.notes: Performance Battery 79.2 kWh gross (single deck), Performance Battery Plus 93.4 kWh gross; max DC 225 kW and 270 kW; 5-80% in 22.5 min; optional on-board charger up to 22 kW (European text). Net capacity not stated.

sources.title: Porsche Taycan (Wikipedia)
sources.notes: Packs 2019-2024: Performance Battery 79.2 kWh gross / 71.0 usable; Plus 93.4 / 83.7. Refresh: 89 kWh / 82.3 net, 105 kWh / 97 net. 270 kW before, 320 kW after refresh; Performance Battery Plus on Cross Turismo (from 2021) and GTS ("uses the larger battery"); Turbo GT 105 kWh. Charging planner preconditioning. Wikipedia text; references not individually opened.

sources.title: Porsche / Audi 93.4 kWh battery (The Weekly Driver)
sources.notes: Third-party database: 93.4 kWh pack NMC (ratio not published), 93.4 gross / 83.7 usable, 723 V, LG Energy Solution; 79.2 kWh listed NMC; 105 kWh (2025 on) listed NMC 811.

sources.title: The battery: Sophisticated thermal management, 800-volt system voltage (Porsche newsroom)
sources.notes: 800 V system voltage; 33 modules x 12 pouch cells, 93.4 kWh total on the Plus pack; chemistry not named. Battery is preconditioned to a temperature that depends on outside temperature when plugged in.

sources.title: Porsche Charging Planner (Porsche support, US)
sources.notes: Planner "preconditions the battery, optimizing charging performance"; applies to Taycan (2020 to present) and Macan Electric (2024 to present); needs navigation route guidance with the Planner switched on. Cayenne Electric not listed.

sources.title: Porsche Charging Planner and Porsche Intelligent Range Manager (Porsche newsroom)
sources.notes: "the system also regulates the preconditioning of the battery in good time before the charging stop" (route-based, no manual trigger described).

sources.title: New AC on-board charger upgrade for the Porsche Taycan (Porsche newsroom US, 2022)
sources.notes: 19.2 kW charger kit (KB4 option / retrofit) for all Taycan variants, 0-100% in 4.8 h vs 9.5 h with the previous charger. Does not state the previous charger in kW (9.5 h for the pack implies about half of 19.2).

sources.title: Dedicated to choice: Porsche owners can now access the Tesla Supercharger network (Porsche newsroom US, 2025)
sources.notes: US: adapter lets CCS-equipped Taycan and Macan Electric charge at NACS stations; MY2026 includes the adapter, MY2025 free, MY2024 and older $185. Cayenne not mentioned.

sources.title: Dedicated to choice: Porsche customers gain access to the Tesla Supercharger network (Porsche newsroom Canada, 2025)
sources.notes: Canada: CCS Taycan and Macan Electric use Superchargers with a Porsche NACS DC adapter (free for MY2026 and MY2025 Taycan and existing Macan Electric; MY2024 and older Taycan C$250).

sources.title: Model Year 2027 Porsche Taycan updates: E-Shift with virtual gears (Porsche newsroom US)
sources.notes: MY2027: 105 kWh Performance Battery Plus standard across all variants; passenger-side DC port NACS, driver-side AC port J1772 (not on the Turbo GT with Weissach Package); CCS adapter included. No kW or Supercharger statement.

sources.title: 2024 Porsche Macan Specs And Pricing Overview (InsideEVs)
sources.notes: Macan 4 and Turbo: 100 kWh gross, 95 kWh usable, up to 270 kW at 800 V (135 kW at 400 V), 10-80% 21 min; on-board charger 9.6 kW in the US, 11 kW three-phase in Europe; port not stated by Porsche (article assumes CCS1).

sources.title: Battery and charging, the new Macan GTS (Porsche newsroom press kit)
sources.notes: Gross 100 kWh, up to 95 kWh used; NMC 8:1:1 cathode, graphite anode; 800 V; up to 270 kW; 10-80% about 21 min; AC up to 22 kW optional (European text); Charging Planner preconditioning; 6 kW HV heater.

sources.title: Batterie und Laden, the new Macan 4 and Macan Turbo (Porsche newsroom press kit)
sources.notes: Gross 100 kWh, about 95 kWh usable; NMC 8:1:1; 800 V; up to 270 kW (135 kW at 400 V); 10-80% about 21 min; AC up to 11 kW; "The battery is preconditioned for an optimal charging experience", Charging Planner can precondition via route planning.

sources.title: Porsche expands all-electric SUV model lineup with the Cayenne S (Porsche newsroom US)
sources.notes: Gross 113 kWh; up to 400 kW (390 kW optimal conditions), 10-80% under 16 min; J3400 (NACS) DC-only port driver-side rear fender, J1772 AC-only port passenger-side; Porsche CCS DC adapter standard. Usable and AC kW not stated; preconditioning only in Track mode context.

sources.title: Porsche expands all-electric SUV model lineup with the Cayenne S (Porsche newsroom Canada)
sources.notes: Canada release: gross 113 kWh, up to 400 kW, 16 min 10-80% under optimal conditions; ports and AC not mentioned.

sources.title: The high voltage battery in the new Cayenne (Porsche newsroom press kit)
sources.notes: Gross 113 kWh; 800 V; NMCA cathode (86% nickel), pouch cells, 6 modules / 192 cells; two cooling plates heat or cool the battery. Net, DC and AC not stated.

sources.title: The New Porsche Cayenne Electric Hits Reset On What An EV SUV Can Be (InsideEVs)
sources.notes: Cayenne and Cayenne Turbo: usable 108 kWh, 400 kW peak, under 16 min 10-80% (850 V / 520 A charger). AC, port, preconditioning not stated.

sources.title: Charging capacity Cayenne Electric (Porsche support, UK)
sources.notes: Cayenne Electric from model year 2026: AC standard up to 11 kW, 22 kW optional; up to 390/400 kW DC; "the high-voltage battery is preconditioned automatically during active route guidance". UK page, not a North American one.

sources.title: Charging, Cayenne Electric and Cayenne Coupe Electric press kit (Porsche newsroom)
sources.notes: Standard on-board charger up to 11 kW, 22 kW optional (global/European press kit; does not name North America). Covers the Cayenne Coupe too.

sources.title: 2026 Porsche Cayenne EV Battery (batterydesign.net)
sources.notes: 113 kWh declared (112.64 from EPA filing), about 108 kWh usable, nominal 704 V (538-806 V), NMCA / graphite-silicon anode, LG Chem pouch.

Same charger assumed 2020-2024; no 2020-24 page stating the standard charger was found. 9.6 kW is the standard North American charger; 19.2 kW (and 22 kW per the Porsche 2021 European release) are options. 19.2 kW is a US option (KB4, 2022 onward; retrofit for older cars), 11 kW standard in Europe. Canada assumed equal to the US.

battery.nominal_voltage_class.notes: Porsche: "system voltage of 800 volts instead of the usual 400 volts".

battery.preconditioning.notes: Estimated: combines two Porsche pages, each covering half: the range-planner page ("the system also regulates the preconditioning of the battery in good time before the charging stop") and the Porsche US Charging Planner page (planner preconditions the battery; needs route guidance, no manual trigger; Taycan 2020 to present). Charging Planner regulates battery preconditioning before the charging stop while navigating (Porsche newsroom); Porsche US support page applies it to Taycan 2020 to present. No manual battery-preconditioning button found (a departure timer preconditions battery and cabin for the plug-in case).

charge_port.notes: Porsche US/Canada: "CCS-equipped Taycan" needs the NACS DC adapter; CCS1 for North America. Native NACS starts with MY2027.

battery.preconditioning.notes: Estimated: combines two Porsche pages, each covering half: the range-planner page ("the system also regulates the preconditioning of the battery in good time before the charging stop") and the Porsche US Charging Planner page (planner preconditions the battery; needs route guidance, no manual trigger; Taycan 2020 to present). Charging Planner regulates battery preconditioning before the charging stop while navigating (Porsche newsroom); Porsche US support page applies it to Taycan 2020 to present. No manual battery-preconditioning button found (a departure timer preconditions battery and cabin for the plug-in case).

charge_port.notes: MY2027: passenger-side DC fast-charging port is NACS native, driver-side AC port stays J1772; CCS adapter included (the Turbo GT with Weissach Package is the exception; not in this list).

supercharger_access.notes: Estimated: native NACS DC port and Porsche is in the Tesla Supercharger programme (the MY2025 US release covers CCS cars with an adapter; the MY2027 page does not mention Superchargers).
